subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “There is a red door on Apple Street that many children know.”?
options: Students may read, borrow books, or work quietly at the tables.
The next week, children began using it after school.
Children can enter after school, read quietly, and borrow one book at a time.
Some students write before an important exam and read the letter after they enter a new school.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Students may read, borrow books, or work quietly at the tables.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The next week, children began using it after school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Children can enter after school, read quietly, and borrow one book at a time.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Some students write before an important exam and read the letter after they enter a new school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Children can enter after school, read quietly, and borrow one book at a time.」，答案為「Children can enter after school, read quietly, and borrow one book at a time.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Children can enter after school, read quietly, and borrow one book at a time.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
